items.title: Add return-path analysis for non-void functions
items.problem: Non-void functions can fall through without returning, leaving trux_return_value uninitialized and producing undefined behavior.
items.evidence: A function with an if-only return compiled and pick(false) printed stack garbage.
tasks: Implement block termination analysis in types.Check.
Treat return statements as terminating.
Treat if statements as terminating only when both branches terminate and an else branch exists.
Emit a codegen backstop before the function return label that calls rt_runtime_fail("missing return").
Add tests for missing returns, complete if/else returns, and valid void functions.

items.title: Make function and kernel name mangling collision-proof
items.problem: mangleFunc only prepends trux_, so user functions can collide with generated locals or kernel names.
items.evidence: func frame(), func ctx(), and func kernel_scale() alongside kernel func scale can leak C compiler errors.
tasks: Change function mangling to include a stable function namespace such as trux_f_<len>_<name>.
Change kernel mangling to include a separate kernel namespace such as trux_k_<len>_<name>.
Update all call sites, prototypes, declarations, and generated kernel references.
Add regression tests for frame, ctx, and kernel/user-function name collisions.
Grep all generated-name assumptions before committing the migration.

items.title: Guard integer division and overflow
items.problem: Integer division by zero currently raises a raw SIGFPE, and INT64_MIN / -1 is undefined behavior.
items.evidence: 10 / 0 died without a Trux runtime error even though indexing and allocation paths are checked.
tasks: Add an rt_div_int helper in the C runtime.
Fail with rt_runtime_fail("integer division by zero") when the divisor is zero.
Fail with rt_runtime_fail("integer division overflow") for INT64_MIN / -1.
Route generated integer division expressions through the helper.
Add tests for normal division, division by zero, and INT64_MIN / -1.

items.title: Lower side-effecting subexpressions into ordered temporaries
items.problem: Generated C inherits unspecified argument and operand evaluation order.
items.evidence: print(sub(io.readInt(), io.readInt())) with input 10 then 3 printed -7 because gcc evaluated arguments right-to-left.
tasks: Add an IR normalization pass, preferably in ir.Build, that hoists side-effecting calls and reads into ordered temporaries.
Lower f(g(), h()) into let t0 = g(); let t1 = h(); f(t0, t1).
Apply the same lowering to binary operands where side effects are possible.
Make kernels use the normalized IR path as well.
Remove or simplify trimParens and emitCondition string surgery after expression ordering is explicit.
Add tests that prove call arguments and binary operands evaluate left-to-right.

items.title: Compile generated C with -O2 outside debug mode
items.problem: compileGenerated currently passes only -std=c11, so generated programs run at -O0.
items.evidence: The TODO benchmark reports an array-sum program improving from 198 ms at -O0 to 11 ms at -O2.
tasks: Add -O2 to generated C compiler flags for normal builds.
Keep -O0 for the existing DEBUG=1 path if debuggable generated C is needed.
Run existing compiler/runtime tests after the flag change.
Add or document a small benchmark so the optimization flag does not regress silently.

items.title: Pool frame-arena chunks on rt_context
items.problem: Functions that allocate dynamic memory malloc a 4 KB frame chunk on first allocation and free it on return.
items.evidence: A hot string-returning benchmark dropped from 165 ms to 64 ms when generated C reused frame chunks.
tasks: Add a frame chunk freelist to rt_context.
Make rt_arena_deinit donate eligible chunks to the freelist.
Make rt_arena_new_chunk check the freelist before malloc.
Preserve recursion safety by avoiding a static shared arena.
Add tests or stress programs covering nested calls and recursion with pooled chunks.

items.title: Use arena marks and rewinds for non-escaping loop temporaries
items.problem: Loop body temporaries can accumulate in the caller frame arena until the caller returns.
items.evidence: A 2M-iteration string benchmark peaked at 33 MB RSS for roughly 2 bytes of live data.
tasks: Use rt_arena_mark_current at the top of eligible loop bodies.
Use rt_arena_rewind at the bottom of eligible loop bodies.
Consult ownership information to skip rewinding when allocations escape the iteration.
Account for variables declared outside the loop that receive loop-created allocations.
Add tests or stress programs for escaping and non-escaping loop allocations.

items.title: Reduce smaller runtime allocation overheads
items.problem: Several runtime paths allocate more than needed or perform avoidable buffering.
items.evidence: TODO.md notes three mallocs for list creation, double-buffered rt_read_file, and fixed 4 KB chunk growth.
tasks: Evaluate placing list structs in the arena while only registering the data pointer.
Change rt_read_file to stat the file, allocate once in the arena, and read once.
Consider geometric arena chunk growth for large frames.
Benchmark each change separately before keeping it.

items.title: Delete funcUsage tracking from C codegen
items.problem: funcUsage exists only to decide whether to emit unused-parameter casts, forcing double buffering and extra plumbing.
items.evidence: TODO.md says funcUsage threads usage through eight function signatures just to decide on trux_ctx and trux_result_arena casts.
tasks: Emit (void)trux_ctx and (void)trux_result_arena unconditionally where those parameters exist.
Remove funcUsage, noteArena calls, and the body double-buffering used only for usage tracking.
Remove usage parameters from emit helpers.
Run codegen tests and generated C compiler checks.

items.title: Replace collectNestedCollectionFamilies with used type tracking
items.problem: The hand-rolled nested collection traversal must be updated for every new IR node.
items.evidence: TODO.md calls out a 293-line collect*NestedCollectionFamilies walker and recommends recording used types during IR construction.
tasks: Record used types into a set on ir.Program during ir.Build.
Make codegen read program.UsedTypes instead of traversing the full IR for nested collection families.
Alternatively, introduce a reusable ir.Walk helper if multiple passes need traversal.
Delete the obsolete collect*NestedCollectionFamilies walker.
Add coverage for nested list and slice element type emission.

items.title: Simplify codegen impossible-state error handling
items.problem: C codegen returns errors for many states that should be impossible after type checking.
items.evidence: TODO.md reports 99 if err != nil blocks in internal/codegen/c/c.go, mostly around unsupported post-typecheck states.
tasks: Identify errors that represent compiler bugs rather than user-facing validation failures.
Replace impossible-state error returns with panics that include clear compiler bug messages.
Recover once in Generate if graceful CLI output is desired.
Keep real user-facing or environment errors as ordinary errors.
Run the full test suite after reducing error plumbing.

items.title: Deduplicate kernel signature emission
items.problem: emitKernelPrototype and emitKernelFunc duplicate signature logic.
items.evidence: TODO.md recommends giving kernels the same prototype bool treatment as emitSignature.
tasks: Refactor kernel signature emission into one helper with a prototype flag.
Update prototype and function emission to use the shared helper.
Run generated C output tests to confirm declarations and definitions still match.

items.title: Prepare for correct for-loop continue semantics
items.problem: For-loop post statements are emitted at the end of the body, which will break if continue is added later.
items.evidence: TODO.md notes that the usual fix is a goto-able continue label before the post statement.
tasks: Add a continue target label before the emitted post statement when the language grows continue support.
Keep this deferred until continue exists or loop lowering is otherwise being touched.
Add tests for continue running the post statement exactly once per continued iteration.

items.title: Arena ownership analysis survived dangling-pointer probes
items.problem: No action requested by TODO.md for this area.
items.evidence: Returning frame-backed slices, borrowed parameter views, and id(msg + "!") in return position copied out correctly.

items.title: Review go.mod toolchain version requirement
items.problem: go.mod says go 1.26.3 while the project reportedly builds on Go 1.22.
items.evidence: TODO.md notes the Go directive may demand a newer toolchain than the code uses.
tasks: Decide whether the repository intentionally requires Go 1.26.3.
If not intentional, lower the go directive to the actual supported version and run the Go test suite.
